summary: Listed under a tentative name on the Big Ridge, Inverness, Nova Scotia, in a 2009 Nova Scotia DNR tower list; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: CBC says the department's towers were decommissioned in 2015 and later dismantled, but CBC does not name this tower, so its fate is unconfirmed. No source describes this site today.
facts.agency: Nova Scotia Department of Natural Resources

events.note: Listed as River Denys Rd (starred, so a tentative name) on the Big Ridge in a Nova Scotia DNR tower list last updated 18 September 2009 (Marscan). The list says some listed towers are likely decommissioned.
Province-wide: CBC says the department decommissioned its towers in 2015 and then dismantled them. CBC does not name this tower, so this is not a dated fact about this site.

corrections.current: Nova Scotia closed its fire towers in 2013 and had taken them down by 2015 (CBC News); no source says this one still stands.
corrections.proposed: Nova Scotia's towers were decommissioned after 2015 and dismantled. No source describes this site today.
corrections.why: CBC gives 2015 for the department's decommissioning, not 2013. The 2013 date matches the removal of the Nuttby Mountain tower, a different site, not a province-wide closure.

sources.title: 'Not relics from the past': Some firefighters think N.S. should bring back fire lookout towers
sources.publisher: CBC News via Yahoo News Canada

notes_for_editor: Only one site-specific fact: a 2009 list entry under a starred (tentative) name, with the note that some listed towers may already be gone. Fate is not confirmed. CBC's 2015 decommissioning statement is province-wide and does not name this tower, so the status is 'unknown' rather than 'gone', and the story says the fate is unconfirmed. No built date, height, staffing, access or photo was found. The brief's status_note gave a 2013 closure, which conflicts with CBC's 2015 date; see the correction. Searches turned up no other source for this tower. The Canada Lookouts page for it has only the name and region. The county-style descriptor was removed from the story and this file.
